info.mobbottle.mob_bottle_empty: It is just a decoration. It cannot hold mobs.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.mobbottle: MobBottle is a mod that allows you to capture mobs and seal them in a display bottle for decoration. After placing, you can adjust the size, height and direction to admire the sealed mob.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.mobbottle: A mod that captures mobs and seals them in bottle displays
